system.description:
• Effect: +2 to initiative. Once per encounter, take one extra action in the first round — one additional attack or half movement.
  • Untouchable: Once per round, when an attack would hit the Monk, negate it entirely as if the attack had missed — no roll required.
  • Usable a number of times per day equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).
  • Does not work against attacks the Monk cannot perceive (invisible, surprise, etc.).

activities.name: Extra Action
activities.text: In the first round, take one extra action: one additional attack or half movement.

activities.name: Untouchable
activities.text: When an attack you can perceive would hit you, negate it as a miss; usable Wisdom modifier times per day (minimum 1).
